property.proxy_divergence: Previously the conditional gate tested whether an injected callback echoed law/model digest and ref strings and declared predicate_basis='recomputed'; an unresolved law://unresolved/not-present record with display markers could pass. The gate now does not call injected callbacks and always fails conditional authority admission. The old numerical interval code used the requested epsilon after draw-cap shortfall; it now recomputes/compares the frozen plan and uses achieved_epsilon=achieved_shapley_error/2. The old weighted conditional mean divided by sum(weights), which could overflow to infinity; it now max-scales and finite-sums the whole and matched stratum weights.
